articles.summary: SAN JOSE, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Feb. 11, 2026-- QuantumScape Corporation (NASDAQ: QS), a global leader in next-generation solid-state lithium-metal battery technology, today announced its business and financial results for the fourth quarter of 2025, which ended December 31.
articles.title: QuantumScape Reports Fourth Quarter 2025 Business and Financial Results

articles.summary: SAN JOSE, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Feb. 4, 2026-- QuantumScape Corporation (NASDAQ: QS), a global leader in next-generation solid-state lithium-metal battery technology, today celebrated the inauguration of its newly installed Eagle Line at its facility in San Jose.
articles.title: QuantumScape Inaugurates Eagle Line for Solid-State Battery Pilot Production
